root_cause: Original privacy-safe first-party click code used data-bg-meet, then element id, then tagName. It ignored already authored data-bg-conversion and data-bg-order-cta. As a result canonical click labels can become generic BUTTON/A; experiment generator may mistake these telemetry placeholders for actual website copy.

observed_evidence.separate_sender: existing tools/seo-order-engine/measurement.mjs exclusive owner of growth-page commercial events

fix: Prioritize author-controlled static conversion descriptors in original assets/meting.js; never inspect customer-visible textContent/innerText/form field values, preserve same event and original ACK queue
prevention: No AI copy proposal based on tagName-only click label, missing conversion marker or underpowered/consent-limited sample. Separate event label quality from real CTA click and paid order.

test_evidence.expected: safe static action labels before fallback HTML tag; no raw visitor text, no second commercial event producer
test_evidence.deployment: protected GitHub -> Netlify production exact commit -> browser and original event/ACK
